observations: Large office printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
A stack of paper with 'Fancy' and 'KENDO ENTERPRISES' branding is visible on the front.
The printer has three drawers at the bottom.
The top of the machine is covered by plastic, obscuring the control panel and paper output area.
The brand name 'Sharp' is not visible on the front of the unit in the photo.

claims.evidence: The model number is not legible in the photo.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or print correctly.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and producing a test print.

risks.risk: The internal toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be worn out.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum replacement area with the cover open.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new toner cartridge

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may conceal significant surface scratches or mechanical damage.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the top surface and the front control panel area.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner and drum compartment with the cover removed.
Clear photos of the top surface and the front control panel without plastic wrap.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows the label. The shot asked for first would settle it.
